# Wenbo Chen

> Applied Scientist at Amazon working on LLM post-training for the Amazon Ads agent.
> Researcher in LLM and AI agent evaluation, reinforcement learning, and LLM test-time scaling.
> ML PhD, Georgia Tech (NSF AI Institute AI4OPT), advised by Pascal Van Hentenryck.

## Expertise

- LLM post-training (industry): post-training LLMs for the Amazon Ads agent at Amazon (2024 - present).
- LLM and agent evaluation: benchmark design, verifiers, agent skills, agent safety, hallucination detection.
- Reinforcement learning and LLM reasoning: combinatorial RL, parallel test-time scaling.
- Data-driven decision making and optimization (PhD work, industrial adoption).

## Selected work

- [SkillsBench](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12670) (NeurIPS 2026, co-first author): benchmark for how well agent skills work across 87 expert tasks. Adopted as an agentic evaluation by Meta (Muse Glimmer), Qwen, and Tencent HY3. Website: https://www.skillsbench.ai Code: https://github.com/benchflow-ai/skillsbench
- [ClawsBench](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05172) (COLM 2026): capability and safety of LLM productivity agents in simulated workspaces. Website: https://clawsbench.benchflow.ai/
- [Rethinking Evaluation for LLM Hallucination Detection](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.11330) (ACL 2026, first author): introduces TRIVIA+, a long-context RAG hallucination detection benchmark with realistic label noise. Code and data: https://github.com/amazon-science/hallucination-benchmark-trivialplus
- [MARS](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2606.12935): risk-controlled early stopping for parallel LLM test-time scaling, 25-47% fewer tokens at full-budget accuracy. Code: https://github.com/Wenbo11/MARS
- [Latent Spherical Flow Policy for RL with Combinatorial Actions](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2601.22211) (ICML 2026 Spotlight).
- Co-organizer, First Workshop on Agent Skills, ACM CAIS 2026.
